title: 3 Hour Whiskey and History Tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Did you know Denver was founded over a barrel of whiskey? On this 3 hour Colorado Whiskey tour you will learn about Whiskies and their role in the founding of the city. On this walking tour you will visit Denver's oldest Irish Pub, a modern day saloon, and a local Denver distillery. Along the way you will sample different whiskies, learn how high altitude distilling is different than anywhere else and learn some light local history. VALID ID REQUIRED (Co. does not accept vertical ID's)

Stop 1: Nallen's Irish Pub - All tastings and samples are included in the ticket price if you choose that option. Distillery tastings are included

Stop 2: Seven Grand - 750 types of Whiskies, Bourbons and Scotches.

Stop 3: Mile High Spirits - Distillery tastings are included with all ticket options (a $40 value)

Tour needs 4 guests to operate, if there are not enough guests to run the tour you will be 100% refunded.
